title: Lyra: AI Manga Creator
shortDescription: Plan stories, characters, panels, and dialogue, then create manga pages with AI.
fullDescription:
Lyra is an AI manga creator and editor that brings story planning, character settings, panel layouts, dialogue, and image generation into one workflow.

TURN STORIES INTO PAGE PLANS
Organize works, chapters, episodes, and scenes. Develop your story into pages and panels.

EDIT CHARACTERS, PANELS, AND DIALOGUE
Manage character settings and reference images. Adjust panel content, backgrounds, composition, and dialogue to match your creative intent.

REVIEW AI SUGGESTIONS BEFORE GENERATING
Review and edit AI-assisted settings and page outlines. Refine the details before image generation and follow job progress.

CONTINUE YOUR WORK ACROSS WEB AND MOBILE
Use the same Lyra workspace on mobile and the web. Keep personal projects and organization projects separate.

SAVE YOUR MANGA PAGE IMAGES
Review generated manga pages and save page images to your device.

An account is required. Some features require credits or a paid plan. AI generation may take time; review and edit outputs before use. Make sure you have the rights needed for uploaded materials and your use of generated content.

Official website: https://lyra-japan-manga.com/en
Support: https://lyra-japan-manga.com/en/support
